W.note: 5-7-5 (Palm shading the sun=5; pink and green along one edge=7; then the cloud turns white=5); seen iridescent-edge image, but never names the rare cloud and the ending is a bit flat.

X.note: 5-7-5 (Mother-of-pearl veils=5; nacreous light at dusk, slow=7; fire on frozen air=5 if fire is one syllable); accurate nacreous evocation, with a nice 'fire on frozen air' but stacked jewel-words and a dangling 'slow'.

Y.note: 5-7-5 (Nacreous at dusk=5; the pearl drains out of the cloud=7; and we stay, in grey=5); names the cloud, has a real turn as the colour fades and the watchers remain.

Z.note: 4-7-5 (Nacreous glow=4; mother-of-pearl in the dusk=7; the sky holds its breath=5); first line is short a syllable and 'holds its breath' is stock.
